title: Control Room Inside Your Mind (ORIGINAL)
description: Inside your mind is a control room of sorts, but is it really yours or perhaps it is mine? For those slaves who have already listened to lots of my recordings perhaps you already know the answer... But I'm sure just one more brain­washing loop won't be too hard for you to handle. Because now it's time we both explored that thought a little bit deeper. Now it's time I made myself a little more comfortable in your mind. There are so many dials and buttons to play with here, screens and interfaces which could force you to see and feel so many things. Oops — Wouldn't it be a shame if I broke something by pushing too hard? If I twisted just the right amount. Then once I start playing with you there'd be no way to stop. Maybe here I can finally wipe out any resistance you have to my pleasurable hypnotic triggers.
author: Mistress Shibby
